claims: The 98th Academy Awards took place on March 15, 2026.
The Best Live Action Short Film category at the 98th Academy Awards ended in a tie between "The Singers" and "Two People Exchanging Saliva".
The tie marks the seventh tie in Oscar history.
"The Singers" was directed by Sam A. Davis and Jack Piatt.
"Two People Exchanging Saliva" was directed by Alexandre Singh and Natalie Musteata.
"The Singers" is a short adaptation of a 19th-century Ivan Turgenev story.
"The Singers" depicts downtrodden patrons in a pub connecting through an impromptu sing-off.
"Two People Exchanging Saliva" is from France/USA.
"Two People Exchanging Saliva" is a 36-minute absurdist black-and-white tragedy.
"Two People Exchanging Saliva" is set in a society where kissing is punishable by death.
